summaryText: Final-year B.Tech Computer Science student at VIT Vellore. Built a campus marketplace app in React and Node.js used by 1,200 students.
coverLetter: I am a final-year Computer Science student who has shipped a React and Node.js campus marketplace used by 1,200 students. I am comfortable owning features end to end and I am available to start immediately and work full time for the internship duration.
